title: Lever integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About Lever
Lever is a talent acquisition suite that combines applicant tracking and CRM in one platform. It helps recruiting teams source, nurture and hire candidates through a collaborative pipeline with automation and reporting built in.
Why integrate Lever with Xobin?
Integrating Lever with Xobin combines Lever's applicant tracking with Xobin's advanced skill assessments. You can automatically assign assessments to candidates at different pipeline stages, track progress and view detailed performance reports, all within Lever. Connecting the platforms saves time, removes manual tasks and gives you deeper insight into candidate ability, making hiring faster and more data-driven.
Steps to Integrate Lever with Xobin
Enable the integration in Xobin
Log in to Xobin and navigate to the
Settings
page.
Open the
Integrations
tab and locate
Lever
in the list of ATS options.
Click
Generate API Key
and confirm the prompt.
If you are already signed in to Lever you are redirected to the scope confirmation page; log in if prompted and accept the required permissions.
Return to Xobin Settings to access the generated API key.
Configure Lever stages in Xobin
Configure Lever Stages
under the API key section.
A modal opens showing your Lever pipeline stages.
Add Stage
, select a stage and choose an assessment to link to it.
The integration auto-generates a tag for that stage.
Use the plus icon near the assessment dropdown to add multiple assessments to the same stage.
Repeat for other stages and click
Save Changes
Configure Lever for the integration
In Lever go to
Settings > Integrations and API
Webhook
tab and enable the webhook for stage changes.
Open the job posting you want to use the integration on.
Paste the tags generated in Xobin into the
Tags
section of the job posting. They are applied automatically when an opportunity moves to the associated stage.
Manage candidate assessments in Lever
Add a new candidate opportunity to a job position.
Move the opportunity to the Xobin-linked stage.
The assessment tag and a note appear automatically on the candidate's profile.
View assessment results in Lever
Once the candidate completes the assessment you will see two tags:
Completion tag
: indicates the assessment is complete.
Score tag
: displays the candidate's performance level.
A note also appears with the completion date, qualification status, overall percentage score and a link to the detailed Xobin report covering skill analysis, proctoring data, section-wise performance and candidate responses.
Who is this integration for?
The Lever and Xobin integration is ideal for recruiters, HR professionals and talent acquisition teams who want to streamline hiring workflows. It is especially useful for organisations adding skills-based assessment to recruitment. Whether you are a small business or a large enterprise, it helps you manage assessments, track progress and make data-driven decisions inside your existing Lever ATS.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Stage-triggered assessments
Link Xobin assessments to Lever pipeline stages so moving an opportunity forward sends the test automatically.
Auto-generated Lever tags
Each linked stage produces a tag you paste into the job posting, so the right assessment fires for the right role.
Completion and score tags
Finished assessments add a completion tag and a score tag to the opportunity so status is visible at a glance.
Notes with report links
A note on the profile carries the completion date, qualification status, overall percentage and a link to the full Xobin report.
Filter and report by score
Completion and score tags make it easy to segment, search and report on assessed opportunities in Lever.
Zero manual sending
Assessments dispatch on stage change, so coordinators never paste test links into emails again.
Answers
Frequently asked questions
In Xobin Settings > Integrations select Lever, click Generate API Key, accept the Lever permission scopes, then return to Xobin for the generated key.
